notes.title: Stray Gods, a brand new game announcement and an upcoming Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Happy April folks! We hope you survived April Fools okay.

We come bearing news! 

[h3]Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical[/h3]
First of all, as we mentioned in our 2024 sign off, Stray Gods will always be adored by us, but won't be receiving any further updates at this time. However, this doesn't mean we don't have more potential Stray Gods surprises in the pipeline... but no news just yet! 

We'll always be in touch here to let you know about anything new and exciting and Stray Gods related, but for the next little while, our focus is on what's next - and with that...

[h2]Today we're unbelievably thrilled to announce Malys, coming this year and coming soon to Kickstarter! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/f5ba148e950dc7d9313568a7bf2dd94c57b8c327.jpg[/img]

If you've been paying attention on our socials, you might've noticed we've been teasing something for a little while. As Noah, former priest turned exorcist and demon hunter, you ride the streets of a festering city in the dead of night. The city teems with demons, and among them lies your prey: Malys, a demon of extraordinary cunning and power. Use your deck to expose the rot within. Find unique combinations and strategies to withstand the horrors. Help the hopeless and free the possessed, or die in the attempt… over and over again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/08a550287c417acda3ac18d2bdf705e50ef93436.png[/img]

[h2]FAQS[/h2]

If you're signed up to our newsletter you might've seen us address some questions from players, but just in case you missed it...

[b]Is Malys set in the Stray Gods universe?[/b]
Malys is a brand new adventure in a brand new world. We're leaving Stray Gods on the shelf for now, but not necessarily forever.

[b]Will there be romance in Malys?[/b]
There aren't any planned romance mechanics for Malys at this time. There is absolutely yearning. 

There will always be yearning.

[b]Is Malys a musical?[/b]
Malys is not a musical, but music and sound will always be core to the games we make. We aren't saying we'll never go back to the musical format, but we're excited to explore new genres as a team. 

[b]Why a roguelite deckbuilder?[/b]
Honestly?  If you've played or read anything by our creative director David Gaider, you probably know he loves demons. What you might not know is that he also loves deckbuilders. It’s a game genre that David is a real fan of. Malys is a concept that's been burning away in Dave for a long time - just like Stray Gods existed conceptually way back when he worked at Bioware.  We wanted to take our love for characters and genre-twisting stories to tackle a brand new adventure, and that adventure is Malys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/b6f4459ec417d43f0e1d528aa15d3a3b36a25059.png[/img]

Just like we brought Stray Gods to Fig, we're now bringing Malys to Kickstarter in a few weeks. We know that working with all of you to get feedback and collaborate on the final phase of development is going to give Malys the best chance of success. With your help, we can work with you through the Kickstarter to allow us to get a full 1.0 in your hands within the next six months of this campaign launching. 

We need you to make Malys a reality in Summerfall's continued goal of creating amazing character driven, story focused, comprehensive single player experiences free of microtransactions and never-ending roadmaps. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/summerfallstudios/malys-exorcise-demons-on-your-hunt-for-an-ancient-evil?ref=aip50a] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/adea25631a56363830ad33b2926385d901d527c7.png [/img] [/url]
[i]Click above or [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/summerfallstudios/malys-exorcise-demons-on-your-hunt-for-an-ancient-evil?ref=aip50a]here[/url] to sign up to our pre-launch page and join the hunt. Signing up for notifications means you'll be first to learn more about Malys AND gain access to rewards when Kickstarter launches.[/i]

notes.title: Stray Gods and Orpheus in the Myths and Legends Sale!
notes.content:
We're part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/MythsandLegendsSales]Myths and Legends sale[/url], and we thought we'd dig back into our own journey of taking well known characters (like the Greek Gods) and putting a new spin on them. [url=https://screenrant.com/david-gaider-liam-esler-interview/]In this article by Screenrant[/url], David Gaider our lead writer and co-founder went into some more detail.

[i]You're taking existing characters that everyone's familiar with, but we're supporting them. We're thinking, "Okay, what if they had continued to live? How would they have changed?" They have all these stories, so it was great for me to pick and choose which ones to use. "Oh, that story was kind of fake, but there's a kernel of truth to this one," and it grows from there. That was a fun process.

Persephone, for example, who's played by Mary Elizabeth McGlynn. Everybody knows her story, and that she was kidnapped by Hades and brought down to the Underworld and made its queen. But she is sort of annoyed that's where everyone thinks her story ended. In this, Persephone grew very angry and bitter at Hades. She ended up killing him and usurping his throne, and the rest said, "That's not cool, you shouldn't kill other idols," and they stripped her of her throne. So, she's carried all this bitterness; this grudge against her brothers and sisters all this time. And they all have this baggage that's come with them.

If you know the story of the Greek gods, they're a messy bunch. So much drama; so much that we had to work with. Really, it was a matter of figuring how this version of them works over the years. They've all died numerous times, so they all look very different. They're different people but, even so, they have those memories that stretch back for thousands of years. They never just let anything go.

Funny thing is that the older gods—Zeus, Poseidon, Hades, Ares—they've all disappeared or died over the years. The chorus that you encounter, they are the rulers of the islands. But there are other ones that you read into, who have assumed a new importance now that the elders are gone.

Because the gods, while they've been around for so long, are all lost in their individual ways. Persephone is lost in her anger. Apollo is the God of prophecy, but prophecies trap you once you know them. So every time he tries to use his power to help, he actually ends up causing more harm than not. He feels like he can't do anything or create change. He feels helpless and kind of depressed.

They're all kind of lost, and it's up to Grace to see if she can find them.[/i]

What's your favourite myth or legend?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/MythsandLegendsSales]You can check out the sale here.[/url]

notes.title: It's Orphtober with 30% off Stray Gods Orpheus!
notes.content:
It's that time of year again - Melbourne International Games Week! Each year Melbourne International Games Week runs during October, when the sun finally decides to join us here in Melbourne (yay!). It's a mix of events for industry, players, and more - including PAX Australia!

What could be better in October than surprises? As a TREAT for you in honor of the not one, not two, but THREE AGDA's we won last year, we're putting Orpheus on sale for the first time at a whopping 30% off.

This year, we're taking things a little more gently than our hectic last year, but we wanted to still share the love with you of course! Last year we had a bumper week. In case you missed it, we: 

[list]
[*] held a live [url=https://vimeo.com/888937015]free Stray Gods Fashion Show[/url] in Federation Square, a huge outdoor space in Melbourne. 
[*] David (creative director), Ben (art director) and Liam (managing director) were the focus of a [url=https://youtu.be/ZRmCl1GldzU?list=PLmVd3Ba8-qeBK79hYN8Vo-5587ZLUWptV]Directors in Conversation evening at ACMI[/url], Australia's national museum of screen culture.
[*] had a panel at PAX Australia where we shared [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1944581184]Secrets, Stories, Myths and Mistakes[/url] from behind the scenes of Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical

[*] and most exciting of all - won THREE awards at the Australian Game Developers Awards including Game of the Year, as well as Excellence in Music and Excellence in Accessibility. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/0dce7fb86e30487a54b26c81e5b332e82a9edfe5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Stray Gods: Orpheus is OUT NOW
notes.content:
The bard is back! 

Orpheus’ story is arguably finished - until Hermes brings him back to the world of the living. Guide Orpheus through the depths of mortal decision making - who to date, what to hope for, what instrument to rock out on… Starring Anthony Rapp, Erika Ishii, and written by David Gaider, Stray Gods: Orpheus is a comedic feature length experience that history buffs, hopeless romantics, and rock stars alike can enjoy.

Experience 6 brand new original songs, composed by Austin Wintory, with lyrics by Simon Hall (Tripod), Montaigne and new addition Tom Cardy. When the curtain has fallen and the show is over, who do you go home as? Is the mortal world ready for the return of Ancient Greece’s most infamous bard?

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical Patch
notes.content:
Hello folks!

With Stray Gods: Orpheus about to take the stage, we thought it'd be a great time to revisit Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical with some updates & fixes in one final and beefy patch. Thanks to those of you who have reached out to the team along the way and helped us investigate these issues — our team couldn't have done it without you!

Today’s final Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical patch includes the following:

Gameplay

- Fix for bug where trait selections were incorrectly inaccessible
- Fixes for bugs when pausing during load screens/audio descriptions
- Additional Optimization
- Several minor cinematic fixes
- Minor environmental tweaks

Menus/UI

- Fixes for Option Menu bugs (some visual and technical)
- Update to New Game Menu to make overwriting saves more explicit
- Removed Gamesight functionality
- Re-sized UI scaling to handle localized text
- Re-localized some text that was not translated
- Fix for some subtitles not appearing
- Improved controller navigation
- Support for Stray Gods: Orpheus

We hope these fixes find you well - and just in time to enjoy Stray Gods: Orpheus! 

It’s about time for an encore don’t you think?

xoxo, 

Summerfall

notes.title: Myth and Music Part Two: YouTube Premiere!
notes.content:
What a year! We don’t know about you, but Summerfall is very keen to be taking some time over the holidays to relax and regroup after a huge year for us... but one last thing before we go!

Some of you may have seen it live, others as a VOD, or even here on Steam - back in April of this year, we held a show called Myth and Music: An Evening with Stray Gods live at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles., where we debuted a number of songs from the game, revealed our cast, and dropped the release date trailer for Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical - and streamed it all on the Critical Role Twitch. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_kzo2RBCXho&pp=ygUXbXl0aCBhbmQgbXVzaWMgcGFydCBvbmU%3D]You can watch part one here.
[/url]
However! There was a second portion to this show that we kept as a secret - that included performances from Laura Bailey, Troy Baker and Anjali Bhimani and an interview with David Gaider and Austin Wintory. These elements were [i]very [/i]spoilery to the full game, and we wanted you to get the chance to enjoy the surprises of Stray Gods in real time.

Now that some time has passed since release, we're so thrilled to share with you the NEVER BEFORE SEEN second part of our Myth and Music: An Evening With Stray Gods live event. The 30 minute video will be released as a [b][url=https://bit.ly/mythandmusicpart2]YouTube Premiere on December 13 at 6pm PST/December 14 at 1pm AEDT[/url][/b], with the Summerfall team on hand in the chat to provide fun facts during the premiere! Please join us as we watch and reflect on the event as a team.

Happy holidays from all of us - we hope you like your gift.

Summerfall Studios

notes.title: We Need Your Help for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
It's been almost THREE ENTIRE months since we released Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical and things haven't slowed down! We've had award nominations (and some wins), live fashion shows, streams and more. Now, as the holidays approach (extremely quickly) we're asking for your help in the upcoming Steam Awards for 2023.

Whether you've listened to one playthrough or one hundred, we hope you understand just how much love and care went into creating a soundtrack that could tell Grace's story how YOU saw it. With four soundtracks on Spotify (that still don't nearly cover all the potential choices and song paths you can take), music is the core of what makes Stray Gods special. 

The amount of music we crafted for this game would require you to play [b]once every day for 75 years[/b] (a total of [i]27,375[/i] playthroughs) in order to hear everything. Even now, three months on, only 1.1% of you have unlocked the Maestro achievement - and it required a lot of community work and love to figure out how!

All this to say - if you enjoyed Stray Gods, if you loved the music, if Adrift sneaks into your brain once a week and refuses to leave, we'd deeply appreciate your nomination for Best Soundtrack in this years Steam Awards. 

Every nomination, award, and celebration helps us as a studio and as a team. Every time you share the game with a friend, wishlist us, leave a review, we are encouraged and delighted. 

Thank you for playing Stray Gods - we hope it means as much to you as it does to us!

notes.title: Stray Gods is GRAMMY nominated?!
notes.content:
Some of you might've seen the news - we're nominated for a GRAMMY.

WHAT?!

It's taken an entire weekend for us to even wrap our heads around this. We're absolutely over the moon to share this incredible news with you. Your passion, dedication, and support have propelled us to new heights, and we're beyond grateful for the journey we've taken together. Whether you've been with us from the beginning or just joined the adventure, your enthusiasm has been our driving force. 

A huge congratulations has to - of course - go to the ever-brilliant Austin Wintory, Montaigne, Tripod, and the rest of the music team who crafted the soul-stirring melodies and epic soundscapes that made Stray Gods a truly memorable experience. Shout out to the other incredible nominees, a massive year for games.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for making this possible. Let's celebrate together and, who knows, maybe we'll be adding a shiny Grammy to our trophy collection!

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical wins Game of the Year at the AGDAs!
notes.content:
Last week was Melbourne International Games Week and Summerfall had a HUGE week - including winning three awards at the Australian Game Developer Awards.

We've been all over Melbourne - with a live free [url=https://www.smh.com.au/technology/video-games/zelda-in-zimmermann-your-favourite-video-game-character-could-be-the-next-big-thing-in-fashion-20230928-p5e88c.html]Stray Gods Fashion Show[/url], a [url=https://www.acmi.net.au/whats-on/migw-film-series/stray-gods-talk-screening/]Directors in Conversation[/url] evening, a [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1944581184]PAX Panel[/url], a bunch of talks at Games Connect Asia Pacific and more, we picked up three awards at the AGDA's including Game of the Year, as well as Excellence in Music and Excellence in Accessibility. 

We're so grateful to be recognized by our peers and a huge congratulations to our fellow nominees and winners. 

You can watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ynY_hQQ9Yi4]whole awards ceremony here[/url] if you'd like, and thank you again for all your support.

Also, we're taking your questions! Got something you want to ask us about the development of Stray Gods? Some burning questions or things you've noticed and want confirmed? You can leave us a comment here, or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@summerfallstudios/video/7285828129120111880]respond on TikTok[/url] where we'll be sharing the answers!

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical - Patch #1.2
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We recently released a patch with a number of fixes but unfortunately upon release some players encountered unexplained crashes. Because of this, we made the decision to roll it back.

We're happy to say we're releasing a new patch today!

This patch includes the following fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed voiceover equalisation, which brings the volume of each character’s VO into alignment.
[*] Fixed a number of issues that were causing crashes.
[*] Fixed various issues where binding actions to specific keys didn't work as intended.
[*] Fixed some localisation issues.
[*] Removed brackets from some speaker labels to make them more readable. (The last encore for our beloved ‘Ibothi’ and ‘Ialli’)
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get similar conversations with Pan one after the other during the Medusa storyline.[/list]
Thank you again for your support and feedback. As always, if you encounter any further issues please reach out to us [url=https://6k8iky9gz49.typeform.com/to/LWtqd0Y6]via our support form[/url] so our team can investigate.

And a 5 6 7 8!

notes.title: Patch Rollback
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thank you so much for your enthusiasm for Stray Gods as we continue to improve the game.

Earlier today, we soft launched a Patch #1.1 on Steam, which aimed to address the audio imbalance, localisation fixes, some keybinding issues, and more. However, we are receiving reports that the patch is causing some game crashes.

We have decided the best course of action is to roll back this patch and re-release it after we’ve remedied the problem. 

We are very thankful of the patience of our community!

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical review
notes.content: I've played dozens of visual novels and narrative adventures in my time, and I've still never experienced anything like Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical. It's a game that delivers its branching narrative through song rather than the spoken word, boasting a talented cast of voices from Laura Bailey and Troy Baker to Ashley Johnson, Felicia Day and Rahul Kohli. For the most part, it's a wonderfully engaging adventure—even if it is unfortunately let down at points by a lack of attention to detail... Read more.

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical - Hotfix #1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We appreciate the patience you've given us as we've been investigating this save issue. We believe we have found the cause, and we're here today with a hotfix that we believe will resolve the save issues you've been experiencing.

At present, we believe the issue came up due to the way in which the game was handling initial save files - that is, demo save files had the potential to cause issues with players games if they had them, including crashes. To prevent this, the system is taught to wipe these initial saves to ensure you don't encounter crashes and an unplayable game. However, the way in which the system detects these saves made an error, causing it to identify your first new saves as potential demo saves.

This also accounts for why players do not and have not (at least from our reports) encountered the issue again. We've made adjustments to how the system checks these files and are pushing this build now. 

You should take care not to load any saves from your demo playthrough as it will likely cause issues. Overwriting those saves with new games will ensure everything runs smoothly.

If you encounter any further issues, please do continue to submit [url=https://6k8iky9gz49.typeform.com/to/LWtqd0Y6]via our bug report form.[/url]

[b]CHANGES[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fix to address save versioning incorrectly deleting saves[/list]
Thank you and enjoy Stray Gods!

Summerfall Studios

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical - Save File Loss Information
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Firstly, thank you for your support and celebration on the release of Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical. We are so grateful to see you enjoying the game! 

We've had a few bug reports, but our biggest focus has been those of you affected by issues with save files and progression loss. As avid choice-based narrative fans ourselves, we know how frustrating this can be to lose your progress.

We're getting closer to a fix that should resolve this for players who are booting the game for the first time. Our team are going to be working this weekend to resolve it for you. At this stage, this bug only seems to be affecting players' [i]initial[/i] save file - that is your first created save, regardless of save slot. No one has encountered the issue after this point that we know of when they start a second save. If you have, please let us know via the support form below. 

In the interim, we ask that any player launching the game for the first time do the following steps:

1. Launch the game
2. Agree or Decline Gamesight's prompt
3. Exit the game using 'Exit Game'
4. Relaunch the game 

If you'd like to be extra cautious, you can play the first scene until you see the save logo in the top left corner, then exit using 'Exit Game'. While we can't guarantee this will stop every issue from occurring with progression and saves, this should allow you to start a new game with no save file issues. 

We are so grateful for your patience. As a small team in a sometimes challenging timezone, every bit of kindness and Grace (we had to) is appreciated. Your reports allow us to investigate these issues swiftly and effectively, and we know it takes time and energy to submit them. 

Thank you and we hope you enjoy your time with the game,

Summerfall Studios

notes.title: Soundtrack Announcement!
notes.content:
We're so excited to announce our four soundtracks for Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical! 

Red Edition: consisting of your Kickass choices
Blue Edition: consisting of your Clever choices
Green Edition: consisting of your Charming choices
Pantheon Edition: a mix that zig zags across all three decision paths, including the score!

notes.title: Stray Gods has changed its release date to avoid Baldur’s Gate 3, which changed its release date to avoid Starfield
notes.content: Remember back in late 2020, when the looming behemoth of Cyberpunk 2077 caused a bunch of other game developers to change their release dates to avoid being steamrollered? It's happening again, sort of: Summerfall Studios, the developer of David Gaider's upcoming musical RPG Stray Gods, announced today that it's delaying the game slightly, from August 3 to August 10, so it doesn't get murdered by Baldur's Gate 3... Read more.

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical Date Update
notes.content:
We’re so excited - Stray Gods is under a month away!

We’re counting the days and we know you are too, but we need to make a slight adjustment to the calendar. We’re moving our launch date to [i]August 10th, 2023.[/i]

We want everyone to have ample space to check out Stray Gods when it launches. Baldur’s Gate 3 is hotly anticipated (by us, too!) and we want to give our fans room to celebrate Stray Gods.

We also want everyone to be able to play on their preferred device at launch. This is a huge undertaking for any team, let alone an indie shipping its first title. This extra week allows us to have performance parity as close as possible - across every platform.

We're so excited to share Stray Gods with you and we hope you'll join us on August 10th to play and celebrate this game we've poured so much love into!

notes.title: An Award Win & Language Announcement!
notes.content:
Some exciting news - Stray Gods has won its first award!

We won Best New Game at the Brazil Indie Games Festival which is a huge honour. To know that people are recognising Stray Gods before it's even out in the world is so special for the team - and we appreciate each and every one of you for being excited with us.

Not only that, but some of you may have noticed in your playthroughs of the demos that your subtitles defaulted to some system languages... well, that's because Stray Gods will be available at launch in 5 additional languages: French, German, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), and Spanish. 

Fully subtitled, this means fans in those regions can enjoy the performances and musical numbers without barriers - while still hearing our incredible cast sing.

We know these languages don't cover everyone, but we hope this makes a difference for many of you!
